data.body: [P2] Return to the design phase to explain the simpler alternatives. CONTRIBUTING.md rule 2, “Simplify before you add,” explicitly requires the description to state which simpler options were considered and why they do not work when adding logic. This adds a handler and deployment resource, but the description only explains the selected implementation and references the upstream requirement; it provides no alternatives analysis. That leaves the approach unjustified against the repository’s simplicity requirement. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, document the alternatives and chosen rationale, and obtain agreement before continuing.
